title: jasminum forstenii var. ensatum
intro: Jasminum forstenii var. ensatum, commonly known as the Forsten's jasmine, is a variety of flowering plant in the olive family (Oleaceae). The plant is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, anxiety, and stress due to its adaptogenic properties. The therapeutic actions of Forsten's jasmine are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, the plant's essential oil has been traditionally used in aromatherapy to promote relaxation and improve mood.
